uncited: Extract `cov` elements into `hata, hatb, hatc, hatd, hate, hatf`.
Compute determinant $det = hata \cdot hatd \cdot hatf + 2 \cdot hatb \cdot hatc \cdot hate - hata \cdot hate^2 - hatf \cdot hatb^2 - hatd \cdot hatc^2$.
Compute max scale in voxel units: $max\_scale = \max(\max(scale.x/dVoxel_x, scale.y/dVoxel_y), scale.z/dVoxel_z)$.
Call `getCube(point_vol, my_radius, cube_min, cube_max, grid)` to determine bounding voxel cube.
